mechanism: NSAIDs like celecoxib can reduce renal blood flow and increase serum creatinine, potentially reducing amoxicillin clearance and increasing antibiotic levels; additionally, NSAIDs may increase GI ulceration risk when combined with antibiotics in susceptible patients.
action: Monitor renal function and antibiotic efficacy; ensure adequate hydration; consider gastroprotection if GI risk factors present; use lowest effective NSAID dose for shortest duration.
